note: Rectangles are image pixels. Every label comes from the figure legend of Vergier et al. 2024 (Cureus 16(3):e56077, Figure 2, CC BY 4.0); nothing about the patient is added.

labels.en: A: the cancer on the gum beside the right lower back teeth (45 to 47): a raised, white and red patch.
labels.ja: A：{右下|みぎした}の{奥歯|おくば}（45〜47）の{横|よこ}の{歯肉|しにく}のがん。{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった{白|しろ}と{赤|あか}の{部分|ぶぶん}。

labels.en: B: a second patch on the inner (tongue) side of the gum between the lower front teeth 42 and 43.
labels.ja: B：{下|した}の{前歯|まえば}42と43の{間|あいだ}の、{内側|うちがわ}（{舌|した}{側|がわ}）の{歯肉|しにく}の2つ{目|め}の{病変|びょうへん}。

labels.en: C and D: tissue samples under the microscope, confirming squamous cell carcinoma (C) and a marker stain (D).

labels.en: E: PET scan slice. The bright spot in the right side of the jaw is the cancer taking up the tracer.
